meta.scope: Argentina batch 6 (final expansion) — Energy & mining statistical layer: IPI minero, hydrocarbon production (Vaca Muerta / Neuquén), lithium, and provincial energy-export link. Closes the Argentina core before moving to Chile.

candidates.title: Índice de Producción Industrial Minero (IPI minero)
candidates.description: Monthly volume index of mining and hydrocarbon extraction activities. Covers crude oil, natural gas, metallic and non-metallic minerals, including lithium. Published with original and cumulative series.
candidates.notes: Key short-term indicator for the energy and mining boom. First-half 2026: +8.4% cumulative. Driven by non-conventional oil (+35% range) and lithium carbonate (+49% range). Complements the manufacturing IPI.

candidates.title: Vaca Muerta / producción de hidrocarburos no convencionales (Neuquén)
candidates.description: Statistical representation of the Vaca Muerta shale play and non-conventional hydrocarbon production, concentrated in Neuquén. Dominates national crude-oil growth and is visible in the IPI minero and provincial export origin statistics.
candidates.notes: Transformative energy node. Without Neuquén/Vaca Muerta, national crude production would be at multi-decade lows; with it, 2025 set records. Appears in IPI minero (non-conventional oil), provincial export origin (Neuquén rising share), and energy-balance analysis.

candidates.title: Provincia de Neuquén — core statistical identity (energy province)
candidates.description: Patagonian province whose statistical profile is now dominated by Vaca Muerta hydrocarbon production and related fiscal/export effects. Rising share of national merchandise exports.
candidates.notes: Energy-specialised provincial node. Complements the earlier Córdoba/Santa Fe (agro-industrial) and Chaco/Formosa (higher-poverty) provincial contrasts.

candidates.title: Producción de litio / carbonato de litio (estadísticas mineras)
candidates.description: Physical and index measures of lithium carbonate and related lithium minerals production, published within the IPI minero framework.
candidates.notes: High-growth critical-mineral series. First-half 2026 lithium carbonate production +49% cumulative; monthly physical volumes regularly published. Completes the mining layer alongside hydrocarbons.

candidates.title: Exportaciones de combustibles y energía / complejo petrolero-petroquímico
candidates.description: Trade statistics for the fuels & energy large rubric and the oil-petrochemical export complex. Directly linked to Vaca Muerta production growth.
candidates.notes: Trade counterpart to the production indices. Oil-petrochemical complex was the second-largest export complex in 2025 (~13.5% of total goods exports).

proposed_edges.basis: Mining and hydrocarbon extraction feed into the monthly activity estimator.
Non-conventional hydrocarbon production is the dominant driver of the oil & gas component of the IPI minero.
Vaca Muerta production is geographically concentrated in Neuquén.
Fuels & energy and the oil-petrochemical complex are standard rubrics/complexes within merchandise trade statistics.
Lithium production is reported inside the mining production index.
